name: Sekimura Mikado
source:
An intellectual who acts like a polite gentleman to everyone. However, he's actually an otaku whose true nature is revealed in front of people who let him down.

In order to convince his father, who is a bureaucrat, he is also doing his schoolwork perfectly in parallel with his idol activities.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#sekimuramikado]official website[/url]]
